parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Kor-road (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1916 | 1.24 | 1.24
2 | 1252 | 1.79 | 3.03
3 | 1658 | 108 | 111
4 | 581 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Kor-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: AK-type
Aquifer depth: >111 m (top of Layer 4, low-resistivity zone, base not delineated by survey)
Recommendation: Target drilling below 111 m depth to intercept the low-resistivity (581 ohm-m) Layer 4, which likely represents the main water-bearing zone; ensure adequate casing through the resistive overburden (Layers 1–3, 0–111 m) to prevent borehole collapse and to isolate potential perched or less productive zones before reaching the target aquifer.
